race.description: More From Tote With Ladbrokes Plate (C1)
race.comment: STORMING HOME (12) pushed forward here two weeks ago and kept finding to hold on and score over this trip when resuming. Has plenty of scope for improvement and keeps Thompson piloting. Can win again. IMMINENT APPEAL (3) get off the mark in style last time at Doomben and can go on with it now, but is another that has a wide draw to overcome. MONOTONE (5) made a complete mess of his rivals in his stable debut but failed to repeat the dose last time when getting too far back and not letting down with the same zip. Willing to give another chance. IDYLLIC AFFAIR (7) battled on soundly fresh in what has proven a hot form reference. Treading cautiously second-up off such a long break but she does look to have her share of ability and is worth keeping in mind. CAMELIGHT (1) returns and looks to have his share of ability. One to keep safe, especially if the support is there.
